cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I open the scholarship letter, do we have clean teaspoons?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made your tea. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You've put sugar in mine. I'll need another cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we swap cups, how will you know which has sugar? We need labels before anything gets mixed up.

mechanism: A keeps correcting its pupil tea-making details to avoid opening a scholarship result and discussing separation fears.
confusable: Not mere preference for proper tea: A replaces each solved practical detail when B nears the emotional question.
comparison: Tea ritual and result letter versus travel paperwork.
